messages:
leila: Quick pulse check  I'm assembling a compact 'Stoplight' acceptance rubric for the multi-tier inference rollout. Need green/amber/red criteria from Docs, SRE, Billing, Support by COB.

omar: Please dump the lanes here.

leila: Lanes: safety/regression, latency & SLOs, telemetry + alerts, customer-facing docs/runbooks, pricing/quota + billing UX. Each lane => a 3-line pass/amber/fail rule and owner.

devin: I'll take billing/quota. Deliverables: explicit free-tier throttle text, committed vs burst pricing table, preview-credit flow, and KV-cache billing note. Also short example message payload for SDK throttle (HTTP 429 + body).

sre-bot: Reminder: deploy automation requires tested circuit-breaker and rollback endpoint. Owner: eng-runtime.

omar: On SLOs I propose a row-level stoplight: GREEN if p95 <= 320ms standard & error <0.25%; AMBER if p95 <= 2x target or error 0.25-0.6%; RED otherwise. Degradation action: on AMBER trigger automated traffic shed to compatible model and page on-call.

leila: Safety/regression: must have a small smoke set (2k prompts) run pre-rollout. GREEN = no >5% quality drop on key intents; AMBER = localized regression with mitigation plan; RED = blocker. Owner: applied-ml.

devin: For billing non-negotiable: Dedicated trial overage clause and contact point for manual quota bumps. Finance signoff required for GREEN.

leila: Telemetry: GREEN if per-model token meter, request-id -> trace join, and cost-per-token burn chart exist; AMBER if one missing but workaround documented; RED if none. Alerts: SLO burn >60%/5m => paging; error spike >0.5%/1m => paging. Owner: eng-infra.

omar: Docs/runbooks: GREEN if a 1-pager exists for customers + an internal incident playbook with triage checklist and escalation matrix. Include a short rollback command snippet, e.g.:
```
# rollback to previous routing
redwoodctl route set --model stable-v2 --weight 100
```

devin: Support: we need a staffed 48-72h post-launch rota (eng-sre + eng-platform pairing). GREEN = rota staffed + Tier1 CS playbook uploaded. AMBER = rota only partially staffed. RED = no rota.

leila: Gate to GA = all lanes GREEN. Move to soft-launch (limited traffic) if any AMBER but with mitigation and exec signoff. RED blocks go.

omar: Timeline: Docs + Billing quick-check today, eng-runtime to smoke-test fallback tomorrow, infra dashboards by Thu, load test Fri.

devin: I'll publish throttle text and mock 429 payload by 17:00 and loop finance.

sre-bot: Deploy window logged: 2025-06-02 03:00 UTC. Confirm rota 48h prior or bot will block.

leila: Non-negotiables: 1) automated fallback + tested rollback, 2) Dedicated trial overage policy signed, 3) customer-facing throttle messaging. Call out any other hard blockers now.

omar: Add: measurable cost-per-token metric in dashboards is non-negotiable for release.

devin: Finance will need the draft billing text before 15:00 to make signoff.

leila: Thanks all 44d I'll synthesize the Stoplight doc and add owners in the launch tracker. Reconvene tomorrow 09:30 for final decision.
